errorCodes.meaning: The network has no entry for the issuer, or none in a state that holds an offer: the party is not listed, repudiated the listing, departed or was removed.
The issuer's entry is `acknowledged` or `suspended`: the grant is already signed, and there is no offer left to acknowledge.

Credential.description: A DTG credential (W3C VC 2.0, JSON) exactly as signed. Verified by the party relying on it, never by its shape here: it is an open object so a binding cannot narrow away a member the proof covers.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

Response.description: The network's membership grant for the party, unsigned.

offer.description: The membership grant the network will sign on acknowledgement, without its proof.
